data.revised_prompt:
Create exactly one 2x2 animation sprite sheet for a 2D game attack FX preview, using the provided reference images: approved preview composition with two avatar medallions and two long jellyfish tentacles, Soft Candy jellyfish as attacker on the left, orange cat avatar as temporary opponent on the right. Output a single square sheet divided into four equal square cells in 2 rows by 2 columns. Background must be 100% solid flat chroma magenta #FF00FF across the entire sheet, including between cells. No visible grid lines, no borders, no labels, no text, no numbers, no arrows, no watermark.

In every cell: same layout, same camera, same scale, same placement. Soft Candy's round avatar medallion on the left, opponent cat avatar medallion on the right. Both medallions slightly smaller than the reference preview, with the entire composition contained within the central 75% to 80% of each cell. Leave at least 50 pixels of flat magenta margin inside every side of every cell; nothing touches or crosses cell edges. No UI. No extra characters. Cute polished HD 2D game FX style, not pixel art. Soft Candy is a cute glossy translucent jellyfish avatar with cyan, lavender, pink, pearl highlights, round face, soft tentacles, underwater-fantasy glow. Opponent is the orange cat avatar portrait in a round medallion. Use clean readable silhouettes and glossy translucent jelly material.

Exactly two main tentacles in every frame, no extra tentacles. The two tentacles are the main moving attack effect: separate soft neon water ribbons with glassy cyan cores, lavender-pink edges, tiny bubbles, subtle electric shimmer. Cute and soft rather than harsh. No gore.

Frame details:
Top-left cell, frame 1 wind-up and extension: two tentacles emerge from Soft Candy's avatar and reach about halfway across the gap toward the opponent, curved and gathering energy, no impact yet.
Top-right cell, frame 2 full reach: the two tentacles stretch all the way to the opponent avatar and make first contact, with small water ripples and tiny bubble sparks at the two contact points.
Bottom-left cell, frame 3 slap impact: the two tentacles snap across the opponent avatar in a clear whip hit, slightly bent from force, bright but soft cyan splash burst, pink-violet spark glints, small shock ripple around the opponent portrait.
Bottom-right cell, frame 4 recovery and afterimage: the two tentacles pull back toward Soft Candy, leaving translucent jelly trails, fading bubbles, and a gentle residual ripple on the opponent avatar.

Ensure the sheet is exactly four equal cells only, flat #FF00FF background everywhere, no underwater blue background, no cell borders, and exactly two readable tentacle ribbons in each frame.
